sections.section_title: LPDMA channel x linked-list base address register (LPDMA_CxLBAR)
sections.text_helper: Section 14.8.4 "LPDMA channel x linked-list base address register (LPDMA_CxLBAR)" in chapter 14 (Low-power direct memory access controller (LPDMA)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 424.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x050 + 0x80 * x (x = 0 to 7)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register must be written by a privileged software. It is either privileged readable or not,
depending on the privileged state of the channel x LPDMA_PRIVCFGR.PRIVx.
This register must be written when LPDMA_CxCR.EN=0.
This register is read-only when LPDMA_CxCR.EN=1.
This channel-based register is the linked-list base address of the memory region, for a given
channel x, from which the LLIs describing the programmed sequence of the LPDMA
transfers, are conditionally and automatically updated.
This 64-Kbyte aligned channel x linked-list base address is offset by the 16-bit
LPDMA_CxLLR register that defines the word-aligned address offset for each LLI.
Bits 31:16 LBA[31:16]: linked-list base address of LPDMA channel x
Bits 15:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.name: LBA[31:16]
